title: 第13章 两个怪物少年第14章 余氏族山
content_zh:
胡同夜雨。
穿着一身武将盔甲的人影，踩着泥泞漫步而来。
“刚才那两个人到底是谁，原本还想靠近一点听听他们说什么……”苏三两摸着下巴，看着胡同内的满地尸体，露出思索之色，“难怪三爷让我们跟着，这位余烬少爷看来藏有不少秘密。”
他迈着小碎步，走到一具尸体旁边，一脚将尸体踢翻，“荒城那些人动作倒是挺快，就是不知道是哪家的杀手，对付一个一境锻骨还要四境强者带队？”
话音落下，天边忽然传来急促的破风声。
刚才那位花裙女子去而复返，身上的裙子明显破碎了好几处，脸上还残留着惊慌失措，等她看清前面那身穿武将盔甲的苏三两时，突然便面如死灰。
“跑什么，你以为今夜你能逃得出老子的手掌心？”高瘦的影子从夜雨中缓步踏出，何千斤脸上带着狞笑。
看着女子脸上的惊慌失措，以及身上外露的春光，再看向何千斤脸上的狞笑，配合此刻的雨夜，苏三两的小脑突然抽搐了一下，“你弄她了？”
何千斤的笑容一僵，吼道：“死胖子放你娘的屁，人给你带来了，有话快点问！”
苏三两讪讪地笑了笑，看向那花裙女子，“别紧张，咱兄弟俩没有恶意，不会杀你，就问你几个简单的问题。”
花裙女子目光闪烁不定，“什么时候开始余氏的虎咆营武将，会护在余烬那废物身边了？”
苏三两一脸笑眯眯，“咱兄弟要是真的守在余烬少爷身边，你和你手下还敢现身吗？况且，余烬少爷可不是个废物啊，你觉得呢？”
花裙女子一脸沉默，眼前的两个虎咆营武将，至少是六境修为，她逃不了！
至于握剑的余烬，与其说是废物，更像是一个……怪物！
苏三两摆了摆手，“好啦好啦，废话我就不多说了，我问你，刚才除了余烬少爷之外，另外两个人是谁？”
花裙女子看了俩人一眼，确认了自己明显没有一丝逃跑的机会，勉强让自己脸上恢复平静，“我不知道他们是谁，但如果说他们是人，不如说是妖。”
苏三两与何千斤愣了一下，俩人对视一眼，苏三两道：“说下去。”
“那坐在墙上的少年我不知道，但是将我吓退的那位，哪怕他掩饰得很好，气息中依旧有着清晰的妖气存在！”
“哦……就不能是什么器物，比如封印有妖力的灵兵？”
“不可能，我与妖族素有交涉，除了那些荒原大妖，见过的妖族并不少，那位的气息里的确有活生生的妖气！”

苏三两露出一个灿烂，“荒城里私底下敢与妖族交涉的势力，就那么几家……你们属于哪一方？”
花裙女子脸色变了又变，却没有任何回应，如果暴露东家的身份，她的下场只有一个死字！
突然，尖锐的鹤鸣声响起，一只手掌从后方直接洞穿了花裙女子的胸膛，看着手上鲜血淋漓的何千斤，脸上却没有任何表情。
花裙女子眼中有着不可置信，“你们……不是说不杀我吗？”
苏三两满脸真挚，“实在抱歉，我们改变主意了，因为余氏绝不可能勾连妖族，所以你必须得死。”
花裙女子眼睛死死瞪着苏三两，然后倒在了泥泞当中，成了胡同巷里又一具尸体。
何千斤看向苏三两，“我们还要不要继续跟着余烬那小子？”
“关于妖族的事可大可小，我们得先回去跟上面汇报一下。”苏三两沉思道，然后轻轻咳嗽一声，“这里就交给你了，你动作快点。”
何千斤眼神疑惑。
苏三两嘴唇微动，吐出两个字。
何千斤：？？？
content_en:
Rainy night in the alley.
A figure wearing a general's armor strolled through the mud.
"Who are those two people just now? I originally wanted to get closer and listen to what they said..." Su Sanliang touched his chin and looked at the corpses on the ground in the alley with a thoughtful expression. "No wonder the third master asked us to follow him. This young master Yu Jin seems to have a lot of secrets."
He walked up to a corpse with small steps and kicked it over. "Those people in Huangcheng moved very quickly, but I don't know which killer they are. To deal with a bone-forging person from the first realm, you need to be led by a strong man from the fourth realm?"
As he finished speaking, the sound of rushing wind suddenly came from the horizon.
The woman in the floral dress just left and came back. The dress was obviously broken in several places, and the panic was still on her face. When she saw Su Sanliang in front of her, who was wearing a general's armor, her face suddenly turned ashen.
"Why are you running? Do you think you can escape from my clutches tonight?" A tall and thin shadow slowly stepped out of the night rain, with a sinister smile on He Qianjin's face.
Looking at the panic on the woman's face and the spring sunshine on her body, and then looking at the ferocious smile on He Qianjin's face, Su Sanliang's cerebellum suddenly twitched in conjunction with the rainy night, "Did you do it to her?"
He Qianjin's smile froze and he yelled: "That damn fat guy farted on your mother. I brought it to you. If you have anything to say, ask me quickly!"
Su Sanliang smiled coquettishly and looked at the woman in the floral dress, "Don't be nervous. We brothers have no ill intentions and won't kill you. I just want to ask you a few simple questions."
The woman in the flower skirt's eyes flickered uncertainly, "Since when did Yu's generals from the Tiger Roar Camp start protecting that good-for-nothing Yu Yan?"
Su Sanliang had a smile on his face, "If our brothers are really guarding Master Yu Jin, will you and your men still dare to show up? Besides, Master Yu Jin is not a waste, what do you think?"
The woman in the floral skirt was silent. The two Tiger Roaring Camp generals in front of her were at least six levels of cultivation. She couldn't escape!
As for the ember holding the sword, it is more like a... monster than a waste!
Su Sanliang waved his hand, "Okay, okay, I won't say any more nonsense. Let me ask you, apart from Young Master Yu Jin, who were the other two people just now?"
The woman in the flower skirt glanced at the two people and confirmed that she obviously had no chance of escape. She reluctantly regained her composure and said, "I don't know who they are, but if they are humans, it is better to say they are monsters."
Su Sanliang and He Qianjin were stunned for a moment. They looked at each other and Su Sanliang said, "Go on."
"I don't know about the young man sitting on the wall, but the one who scared me away, even if he concealed it well, there was still a clear evil presence in his breath!"
"Oh...can't it be some kind of artifact, such as a sealed spiritual weapon with demonic power?"
"Impossible. I have always had dealings with demon clans. Apart from those great demons of the wasteland, I have seen quite a few demon clans. There is indeed a living demon aura in that person's aura!"
Su Sanliang showed a bright smile, "There are only a few forces in the deserted city that dare to negotiate with the demon clan in private... Which party do you belong to?"
The face of the woman in the flower skirt changed again and again, but there was no response. If the identity of her employer was exposed, her fate would be death!
Suddenly, a sharp crane sound sounded, and a hand directly penetrated the chest of the woman in the floral dress from behind. He looked at He Qianjin's hand dripping with blood, but there was no expression on his face.
The woman in the floral skirt had disbelief in her eyes, "Didn't you... say you won't kill me?"
Su Sanliang's face was full of sincerity, "I'm really sorry, we have changed our minds, because it is impossible for the Yu family to collude with the demon clan, so you must die."
The woman in the floral skirt stared at Su Sanliang, then fell into the mud, becoming another corpse in the alley.
He Qianjin looked at Su Sanliang, "Should we continue to follow that boy Yu Yan?"
"Things about the demon clan can be big or small. We have to go back and report to the superiors first.. "Su Sanliang said thoughtfully, then coughed slightly, "I'll leave this to you, so hurry up. "
He Qianjin looked confused.
Su Sanliang moved her lips slightly and uttered two words.
He Qianjin:? ? ?
